messages.subject: Post-stratification for improved variance estimates AND existing
parts:
Hi,

I'm working with a dataset from 7 monthly surveys of 2 species of possum.=


We're using a global detection function, and I've worked out how to get t=
he
appropriate individual estimates nicely (a SpeciesMonth stratum).

But there is a clear density gradient across the systematically-sampled a=
rea
-- the two "end lines" are especially poor. I was hoping to use the
post-stratification-pairing-lines-up technique to estimate the variance
better (the Encounter rate is contributing between 94 and 99% of the vari=
ance).


Is it possible to use this technique alongside existing strata?

Or should I stratify the existing strata into the "poor" end and the "goo=
d"
end, run them separately, then combine the estimates somehow?

Any advice greatly appreciated!

Alex.
